canonical_project: Ningsuan Tibet Cloud Computing Data Center / Ningsuan Data Center Phase I
notes: Tibet government and Tibet Daily sources describe the Lhasa High-Tech Zone project as Tibet's largest/highest-altitude cloud-computing data center: 645,000 m2 site, 400,000 m2 green new-generation data center, 11.8bn yuan over three phases, 70,000 cabinets at full buildout. Phase I was completed/accepted on 2020-12-18; phase I stage 2 had begun in 2020 with 10,000 racks expected after phase I. MW not disclosed.
